# Firebase JavaScript SDK

Unmodified compat browser bundles, version 12.19.0, downloaded from:

- https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.19.0/firebase-app-compat.js
- https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.19.0/firebase-auth-compat.js
- https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.19.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js

Source: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk
License: Apache 2.0 (LICENSE). Preserve embedded copyright notices when updating.

These files are local PWA assets so a saved Firebase Auth session can be restored without a CDN connection. Google sign-in itself still requires the network.
